jtlshopplugin.Name: W System E-Invoice
jtlshopplugin.Description: Create, validate and send XRechnung 3.0 / EN 16931 / Peppol BIS e-invoices from JTL-Shop orders. Validates received invoices too.
jtlshopplugin.Author: W System

Descriptions.Description: XRechnung 3.0, EN 16931 und Peppol-BIS-E-Rechnungen aus JTL-Shop-Bestellungen erzeugen, prüfen und versenden. Prüft auch empfangene Rechnungen.
Create, validate and send XRechnung 3.0 / EN 16931 / Peppol BIS e-invoices from JTL-Shop orders. Validates received invoices too.

Setting.Name: API key (optional)
Setting.Description: Free API key from wsystem.dev for a higher quota. Leave empty to use the free daily quota.

Setting.Name: Format
Setting.Description: Output format of the e-invoice.

Setting.Name: ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF (new, off by default)
Setting.Description: Create a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF (EN 16931) instead of XML only. Not used with Peppol BIS. JTL-Wawi has its own ZUGFeRD export: turn this on only if you do not send Wawi's ZUGFeRD to the same customers, to avoid two invoices per order.

Setting.Name: Create credit notes (new, off by default)
Setting.Description: Create a credit note (type 381, referencing the original e-invoice) when JTL-Wawi pushes the status "cancelled" to the shop, or manually from the E-Invoices tab for returns. Only for orders that already have a valid e-invoice.

Setting.Name: Create automatically
Setting.Description: When the e-invoice is created. JTL-Wawi pushes the status to the shop.

Setting.Name: Business customers only
Setting.Description: Only create automatically for customers with a company name or VAT ID.

Setting.Name: Peppol sending
Setting.Description: Sandbox simulates and delivers nothing. Live delivers over the Peppol network.

Setting.Name: Send over Peppol automatically
Setting.Description: Send automatically after a valid e-invoice (business customers).

Setting.Name: Small business (section 19 UStG)
Setting.Description: No VAT charged. Adds the exemption reason.

Setting.Name: Default Leitweg-ID / buyer reference
Setting.Description: Used when the order has no buyer reference. Leave empty to use the order number.

Setting.Name: Payment terms
Setting.Description: Text for unpaid invoices, e.g. Payable within 14 days.

Setting.Name: Company name
Setting.Description: Your legal company name.

Setting.Name: Country (ISO code)
Setting.Description: Two-letter code, for example DE.

Setting.Name: Email
Setting.Description: XRechnung needs a seller contact email.

Setting.Name: Phone
Setting.Description: XRechnung needs a seller contact phone.

Setting.Name: Contact name
Setting.Description: XRechnung needs a seller contact name.

Setting.Name: VAT ID
Setting.Description: For example DE123456789.

Setting.Name: Tax number
Setting.Description: Optional, when you have no VAT ID.

Setting.Name: Commercial register no.
Setting.Description: Optional.

Setting.Name: IBAN
Setting.Description: Shown on invoices paid by bank transfer.

Setting.Name: BIC
Setting.Description: Optional.
